blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.
blocks.zh: 在自然语言处理(NLP)中,特别是在法律制度复杂的低资源环境下,法律问题回答(QA)相对于法定文本是一项具有挑战性的任务. 它需要准确和以法律为基础的答案。 然而,就目前所知,没有一项现有采掘质量保证基准从所有7个《印度知识产权法》的法规中提供准确的答案。 本文件介绍了印度知识产权法的采掘质量评估基准IndicIPR-QA1。 拟议的数据集包含4 462对来自7个法案中1 116个法定背景的质量保证。 问答使用GPT-4o生成,并通过9个自动质量检查,单模式和多模式的LLM评价,以及200平方英尺的人力审计验证. 科级分接可防止培训、验证和测试集的源文本重叠。 进一步的分析审查了答复的长度、法理上的重叠以及各项法令和个别法令的多语种结构。 BM25实现符号级的F1得分为20.21分,而微调的InLegalBERT则在统一的滑窗推断协议下达到85.02分. BM25 (20.21 F1)和InLegalBERT (85.02 F1)之间的巨大性能差距表明,简单的单词匹配不足以回答这些法律问题. 7个法案的性能也各不相同,表明答案-取出性能有很大差异。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) law covers many economically and socially important areas including pharmaceutical innovation, creative works, agricultural plant varieties, and region specific products. In India, IPR law is covered by seven principal statutes: the Patents Act, 1970; the Trade Marks Act, 1999; the Copyright Act, 1957; the Designs Act, 2000; the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999; the Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design Act, 2000; and the Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers’ Rights Act, 2001. Although these Acts belong to the same legal domain, each covers different subject matter and uses its own terminology, procedures, exceptions, and cross references. As a result, finding the relevant legal provision can be difficult for legal professionals, researchers, and other stakeholders. A startup may need to determine trademark registration requirements; an inventor may need the legal conditions for patentability; a farmer or breeder may need information on plant-variety rights; and a designer or copyright owner may need to identify available forms of protection or remedies. The required information is present in the legislation, but it is often buried in long multi-clause provisions, nested subsections, and specialised legal language. The challenge is therefore not simply accessing the law, but locating a precise and traceable answer within it.
blocks.zh: 《知识产权法》涵盖许多经济和社会重要领域,包括医药创新、创造性工作、农业植物品种和区域特定产品。 在印度,知识产权法由七项主要法规管辖:1970年《专利法》;1999年《商标法》;1957年《版权法》;2000年《设计法》;1999年《货物地理标志(登记和保护)法》;2000年《半导体综合电路布局设计法》;2001年《植物品种和农民权利保护法》。 尽管这些法律属于同一法律领域,但每项法律都涵盖不同的主题事项,并使用其本身的术语、程序、例外和相互参照。 因此,法律专业人员、研究人员和其他利益攸关方很难找到相关的法律规定。 启动人可能需要确定商标注册要求;发明人可能需要获得专利的法律条件;农民或育种人可能需要植物品种权信息;设计人或版权所有人可能需要确定现有的保护或补救形式。 立法中载有所要求的资料,但资料往往包含在长长的多语种条款、嵌套小节和专门的法律语言中。 因此,挑战不仅仅是诉诸法律,而是在法律中找到准确和可追踪的答案。

blocks.en: Statutory Question Answering (QA) also creates a specific evaluation challenge. A plausible paraphrase may be unsuitable when the exact wording of the law is required, while returning an entire provision may be correct but unnecessarily long. A useful benchmark should therefore evaluate both whether the relevant provision is found and whether the answer span is selected correctly. These considerations motivate IndicIPR-QA’s focus on answer in context validity, span minimality, source-separated splits, and item-level error analysis.
blocks.zh: 法定问答(QA)也造成了具体的评价挑战. 当需要法律的确切措辞时,似可加以解释可能不合适,而退回整个条款可能是正确的,但可能很长。 因此,一个有用的基准应评估是否找到有关规定,以及是否正确选择了答复跨度。 这些考虑促使IndicariPR-QA注重上下文有效性的答案,跨度最小,源分离的分割,以及项目级错误分析.

blocks.en: Extractive QA provides a suitable setting for this problem because each predicted answer can be traced directly to its source provision. However, existing QA benchmarks are mainly general domain, contract based, non extractive, or focused on court judgments rather than Indian statutory IPR law. IndicIPR-QA addresses this gap by providing a benchmark for developing and evaluating statutory search and grounded legal QA systems. It is intended as a research benchmark, not as a deployed legal advice system. The major contributions of this paper can be outlined as follows: 1. IndicIPR-QA contains 4,462 extractive QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts covering seven major Indian IPR Acts. The quality of the dataset is validated through nine automatic checks, LLM based evaluation, and a 200 pair human audit by two law graduates. 2. The analysis studies answer length, word overlap between questions and legal texts, multi-clause answers, and differences in answer extraction performance across the seven Acts. 3. Four BERT-based encoders and three open LLMs are benchmarked. BM25 achieves a token level F1 of 20.21, while InLegalBERT reaches 85.02, giving a 64.81 point gap that shows that simple word matching is not enough for this task (Section V ).
blocks.zh: 采掘质量保证为这一问题提供了一个合适的环境,因为每个预测的答案都可以直接追溯到其源提供. 然而,现有的质量保证基准主要是一般领域、基于合同、非采掘或侧重于法院判决,而不是印度的知识产权成文法。 IndicariPR-QA通过为制定和评价法定搜索和基于法律的质量保证系统提供一个基准来弥补这一差距。 它旨在作为研究基准,而不是一个已部署的法律咨询系统。 本文件的主要贡献概述如下: 1. IndicariPR-QA包含4,462对来自1,116项法定背景的采掘QA配对,涵盖7项主要的印度知识产权法案。 数据集的质量通过9个自动检查,基于LLM的评价,以及两个法律毕业生的200对人的审计来验证. 2. 分析研究对长度、问题与法律文本之间的文字重叠、多语种答案以及七部法律中答案提取性能的差异进行了回答。 3. 以4个基于BERT的编码器和3个开放式有限责任公司为基准。 BM25实现了20.21的符号级F1,而InLegalBERT达到了85.02,给出了一个64.81的点差,表明简单的词匹配不足以完成这一任务(第五节).

blocks.en: IndicIPR-QA contains 4,462 extractive QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts covering seven major Indian IPR Acts. The quality of the dataset is validated through nine automatic checks, LLM based evaluation, and a 200 pair human audit by two law graduates.
blocks.zh: IndicIPR-QA包含4,462对采掘的QA配对,来自1,116个法定背景,涵盖7个主要的印度知识产权法案. 数据集的质量通过9个自动检查,基于LLM的评价,以及两个法律毕业生的200对人的审计来验证.

blocks.en: The analysis studies answer length, word overlap between questions and legal texts, multi-clause answers, and differences in answer extraction performance across the seven Acts.
blocks.zh: 分析研究解答长度,问题和法律文本的字词重叠,多语解答,以及七部法案在解答提取性能上的差异.

blocks.en: Four BERT-based encoders and three open LLMs are benchmarked. BM25 achieves a token level F1 of 20.21, while InLegalBERT reaches 85.02, giving a 64.81 point gap that shows that simple word matching is not enough for this task (Section V ).
blocks.zh: 以4个基于BERT的编码器和3个开放的LLMs作为基准. BM25实现了20.21的符号级F1,而InLegalBERT达到了85.02,给出了一个64.81的点差,表明简单的词匹配不足以完成这一任务(第五节).

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing research has introduced several benchmark datasets for question answering and reasoning over legal texts, covering tasks such as extractive QA, statutory retrieval, legal reasoning, contract understanding, and judgment analysis. SQuAD established the standard extractive QA setting, where the answer is selected as a span from a given passage [ 1 ] , and SQuAD 2.0 later added unanswerable questions [ 2 ] . Although these datasets have had a major impact, they use general-domain text and do not capture the structure, terminology, and constraints of legal statutes. Legal QA datasets cover several other settings. CUAD provides expert annotated answer spans from commercial contracts [ 3 ] , while JEC-QA contains multiple choice questions from the Chinese judicial examination [ 4 ] . PrivacyQA, LLeQA, and VLQA focus on privacy policies, legal consultation, and questions from Vietnamese citizens, respectively [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Statutory retrieval benchmarks such as COLIEE [ 8 ] and BSARD [ 9 ] focus on finding relevant legal provisions, while IPBench evaluates LLM knowledge across a broader bilingual set of intellectual property tasks [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有研究引入了若干基准数据集,用于回答问题和对法律文本进行推理,包括采掘质量保证、法定检索、法律推理、合同理解和判决分析等任务。 SQuAD建立了标准采掘QA设置,其中从给定段落[1]中选择答案作为跨度,SQuAD2.0后来添加了无法回答的问题[2]. 虽然这些数据集产生了重大影响,但它们使用一般域文本,没有抓住法规的结构,术语和制约. 法律QA数据集涵盖其他几种设置. CUAD从商业合同中提供专家附加说明的回答跨度[3],而JEC-QA包含来自中国司法考试的多个选择问题[4]. 隐私QA、LLeQA和VLQA分别侧重于隐私政策、法律咨询以及越南公民的问题[5、6、7]。 COLIEE[8]和BSARD[9]等法定检索基准侧重于寻找相关的法律规定,而IP Bench则通过更广泛的双语知识产权任务评价LLM知识[10].

blocks.en: These datasets also differ in how they evaluate legal QA. Retrieval benchmarks mainly measure whether the relevant legal provision is found, whereas extractive QA also requires the correct start and end positions of the answer within that provision. Multiple choice and generative tasks do not directly measure whether the predicted answer matches the source text. Extractive QA is therefore useful when answers need to remain directly grounded in the law. In this setting, answer quality depends not only on finding the correct provision but also on selecting an appropriate answer span.
blocks.zh: 这些数据集在如何评价合法质量保证方面也存在差异。 检索基准主要衡量是否找到相关的法律规定,而采掘质量保证还要求在该条款中正确提出答案。 多重选择和基因任务并不直接衡量预测的答案是否与源文本相符. 因此,当答案需要直接以法律为依据时,提取质量保证是有用的。 在此情况下,答案的质量不仅取决于找到正确的规定,还取决于选择适当的答案跨度。

blocks.en: Research on Indian legal NLP has explored domain-specific language modelling and tasks such as legal statute identification, judgment segmentation, and court appeal prediction [ 11 ] . Statutes and judgments have different structures and purposes: statutes define rules through sections, definitions, provisions, and cross-references, while judgments explain how those rules are applied to specific disputes. LLM assisted data construction provides a scalable alternative to fully manual annotation, but it can also introduce incorrect spans, repeated question patterns, and inconsistent answer boundaries. These issues make careful quality control important when building automatically generated QA datasets.
blocks.zh: 印度法律NLP的研究探索了特定领域语言建模和任务,如法规识别,判决分割,以及法院上诉预测[11]. 规约和判决的结构和目的不同:规约通过章节、定义、规定和相互参照来界定规则,而判决则解释这些规则如何适用于具体争端。 LLM辅助数据构建提供了完全手动注释的可伸缩的替代方案,但它也可以引入不正确的跨度,重复的问题模式,以及不一致的答案边界. 这些问题使得在构建自动生成QA数据集时谨慎的质量控制非常重要.

blocks.en: Overall, existing resources cover legal retrieval, reasoning, contracts, judgments, and broader intellectual property tasks. To our knowledge, existing resources do not provide an extractive QA benchmark covering all seven major Indian IPR Acts. IndicIPR-QA addresses this gap by providing extractive QA pairs with answer spans directly grounded in Indian statutory text, along with quality checks.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,现有资源用于法律检索、推理、合同、判决和更广泛的知识产权任务。 据我们所知,现有资源没有提供涵盖印度所有七项主要知识产权法案的采掘质量保证基准。 IndicIPR-QA通过提供直接以印度法定文本为基础的答案跨度的采掘质量保证对子以及质量检查来解决这一差距。

blocks.en: III Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 三. 数据集建设

blocks.en:
The dataset construction proceeded in five phases:
corpus creation, QA generation, quality control, section level splitting, and audit/validation. Fig. 1 and Algorithm 1 provide an overview of the full pipeline, from raw statute text to the curated benchmark.
blocks.zh:
数据集建设分五个阶段进行:
程序设定、质量保证生成、质量控制、分科以及审计/验证。 图1和算法1概述了整个编审过程,从原始法规文本到编审基准。

blocks.en:
Fig. 1: End-to-end IndicIPR-QA construction. Human-audit percentages denote
joint acceptability on the 200-pair sample; LLM scores are post-hoc diagnostics.
blocks.zh:
图1:端对端IndicaPR-QA建设. 审计百分比表示
在200帕样本上可共同接受;LLM分数是热后诊断.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 IndicIPR-QA: From raw statutes to curated benchmark
blocks.zh: 算法 1 IndicIPR-QA:从原始法规到规范基准

blocks.en: III-A Source Corpus and QA Generation
blocks.zh: III-A 来源公司和质量保证生成

blocks.en: The full text of all seven Indian IPR Acts is collected from official Government of India PDFs available on the India Code portal ( https://www.indiacode.nic.in/ ) using pdfplumber. During preprocessing, table of contents pages were removed, editorial amendment markers such as “Ins.,” “Subs.,” and “w.e.f.” were deleted, and whitespace was normalised. The cleaned text is then divided into 1,173 paragraph-level contexts, each about 1,400 characters long, while preserving sentence and section boundaries. These chunks are called statutory contexts throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 所有七项《印度知识产权法》的全文均来自印度政府官方PDF, 可在使用pdfplumber的印度守则门户(https://www.indiacode.nic.in/)上查阅。 在预处理期间,删除了目录页,删除了“Ins.,”“Subs.,”和“w.e.f.”等编辑修正标记,使白空间正常化。 清理后的文字再分为1,173段级上下文,每段长约1,400个字符,同时保留句子和段边框. 这些块在整个文件中被称为法定背景.

blocks.en: For each context, GPT-4o [ 12 ] is prompted to generate up to five QA pairs. The prompt requires a structured JSON output, questions based on specific facts or legal provisions, and answers copied exactly from the context. It also prohibits paraphrased answers, yes/no or vague questions, answer leakage, and near-duplicate questions. The full GPT-4o generation prompt and generation script are provided in the public repository. 2 2 2 https://github.com/niloycste/Indic-IPR-Dataset- This process generated 5,721 raw QA candidates.
blocks.zh: 对于每个上下文,GPT-4o[12]被激励生成最多5对QA对. 迅速要求有结构化的JSON输出,基于具体事实或法律规定的问题,以及完全从上下文复制的答案. 它还禁止解释性回答,是/否或模糊的问题,回答渗漏,以及近似重复的问题. 公共寄存器中提供了完整的GPT-4生成即时和生成脚本。 2 2 2 https://github.com/niloycste/Indic-IR-Dataset- 这一过程产生了5 721名原始质量保证候选人。

blocks.en: III-B Nine-Step Quality Control Pipeline
blocks.zh: III-B 九步质量控制管道

blocks.en: All 5,721 raw pairs pass through nine sequential filters. F1 checks for non empty fields; F2 verifies that the answer is an exact span from the context; F3 keeps answers from 5 to 350 characters; F4 keeps answers covering less than 85% of the context; F5 requires questions to contain at least five words, end with a question mark, and avoid vague section-summary phrasing; F6 removes questions that contain the answer; F7 removes incomplete contexts; F8 removes editorial amendment markers from answers; and F9 removes standalone 1 to 4 digit answers. Together, these filters remove schema errors, unsupported answers, overly short or overly long spans, weak questions, and extraction artefacts.
blocks.zh: 所有5,721个生配对通过9个连续滤波器. F1 检查非空字段; F2 核实答案是上下文中准确的跨度; F3 保留答案从5到350字符; F4 保持答案覆盖上下文不到85%; F5 要求问题包含至少五个字,以问号结尾,并避免模糊的节摘要词; F6 移除包含答案的问题; F7 移除不完全的上下文; F8 从答案中删除编辑修正标记; F9 移除单独1到4位数答案. 这些过滤器一起消除了计划错误、无支持的答案、过短或过长的跨度、薄弱的问题和提取文物。

blocks.en: F3 and F4 remove 595 and 417 pairs, respectively, accounting for 1,012 of the 1,032 automatic exclusions. This shows that answer span length is the main source of automatic filtering. The remaining 4,689 pairs then undergo context balanced selection. Candidates are ranked based on the length of questions and answers while maintaining coverage across contexts. This produces the final 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts. Removing this selection step reduces test F1 by 1.34 points (Table II ). Finally, section level partitioning creates training, validation, and test sets of 3,710/408/344 QA pairs, with no shared source context across the splits.
blocks.zh: F3和F4分别取消了595对和417对,占1,032自动排除的1,012对. 这表明答案跨度长度是自动过滤的主要来源. 其余的4,689对随后进行上下文平衡选择。 考生根据问答时间长短进行排名,同时保持覆盖各个背景. 这产生了最终4 462对来自1 116个法定背景的质量保证。 删除此选择步骤, F1 测试将减少1.34分(表二)。 最后,节级分区产生训练,验证,以及3,710/408/344对QA对的测试集,在分区之间没有共享源上下文.

blocks.en: III-C Pipeline Ablation Study
blocks.zh: III-C 管道通量研究

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of each filter, a leave one filter out ablation is performed while keeping the remaining eight filters active. Table I reports the number of additional candidates admitted when each filter is disabled.
blocks.zh: 为了评估每个过滤器的贡献,在保持其余8个过滤器活动的同时,保留一个过滤器。 图表 我报告每个过滤器停用时被录取的更多候选人。

blocks.en: The results show that F3 and F4 have the largest effect on the accepted set. Disabling F3 admits 368 additional potentially noisy pairs (+7.8% relative to the 4,689 pair baseline), while disabling F4 admits 417 additional pairs (+8.9%). The main automatically detected issue is answer span length: generated spans are often either too short to be informative or too long, covering most of the source context.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,F3和F4对被接受的组合影响最大. 残疾F3接纳了368对潜在的噪音对(相对于4,689对基线+7.8%),而残疾F4接纳了417对(+8.9%). 自动发现的主要问题是答案跨度:生成的跨度往往太短,不能提供信息,或者太长,涵盖了源上下文的大部分。

blocks.en: III-D Model Level Filter Ablation
blocks.zh: III-D 模型级过滤器

blocks.en: To test whether the quality control pipeline affects model performance, InLegalBERT is trained on six different training-data variants while keeping the validation and test sets fixed. All variants in Table II , including the clean-selected reference, are trained separately in this ablation study. The main baseline model in Table VII is trained separately.
blocks.zh: 为了检验质量控制管道是否影响模型性能,InLegalBERT接受了六个不同的培训数据变体的培训,同时保持验证和测试套件的固定. 表二中的所有变体,包括清洁选用参考文献,均在本次消毒研究中单独培训. 表七中的主要基线模型是单独培训的。

blocks.en: Table II shows that the largest drop in F1 comes from the selection step rather than from any single filter. Removing context balanced selection (heuristic all) lowers F1 by 1.34 points. Using all structurally valid raw candidates lowers F1 by 0.67 points, while removing F4 alone lowers it by 0.21 points.
blocks.zh: 表二显示,F1最大的下降来自选择步骤而不是任何单一过滤器. 删除上下文平衡选择( 全部厚度) 将 F1 降低1.34 点 。 使用所有结构有效的原始考生将F1下调0.67分,而仅去除F4就将其下调0.21分.

blocks.en: The other results are less clear. Removing the answer length filter F3 alone increases test F1 slightly by 0.45 points, and removing F3 and F4 together increases it by 0.47 points. Since these results come from single seed runs and no statistical significance test was performed, the ablation results are treated as diagnostic rather than as proof that each filter improves model performance. The filters are retained because they enforce the answer validity and span quality constraints captured by the automatic checks in Table I . Model F1 alone is not enough to measure these properties.
blocks.zh: 其他结果不太明确。 单去除答题长度滤波器F3会使测试F1稍微增加0.45分,同时去除F3和F4会增加0.47分. 由于这些结果来自单一种子运行,且没有进行统计意义测试,因此将衰减结果视为诊断,而不是证明每个过滤器都改善了模型性能. 过滤器之所以保留,是因为它们执行答题的有效性,并跨越表一自动检查所捕获的质量限制。 单靠F1模型不足以衡量这些属性.

blocks.en: III-E LLM as Judge Quality Verification
blocks.zh: 作为法官进行质量核查

blocks.en: To obtain an additional automated assessment of the 4,462 retained QA pairs beyond rule based filtering, an LLM as judge protocol is applied under two different configurations, and their outputs are compared. These scores are used only as auxiliary diagnostic indicators and not as a replacement for human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了在基于规则的过滤之外获得对4,462个保留QA对的额外自动评估,在两种不同的配置下采用了LLM作为裁判协议,并比较其输出. 这些分数只用作辅助诊断指标,而不是作为人类评价的替代.

blocks.en: Gemma 3:12B [ 13 ] evaluates four criteria: Q_SPECIFIC (the question targets a specific legal element), A_SUFFICIENT (the answer fully addresses the question), A_MINIMAL (the answer is the shortest correct span), and LEGAL_RELEVANT (the question concerns substantive legal content). Scores are 1 (poor), 2 (acceptable), or 3 (good), and a pair is flagged if any criterion receives a score of 1.
blocks.zh: Gemma 3:12B [13] 评价四项标准:XQSpecial(问题针对具体的法律要素)、A_SUFFICIENT(答案充分涉及问题)、A_MINIMAL(答案为最短的正确范围)和法律-RELEVANT(问题涉及实质性法律内容)。 分数为1(差),2(可接受),或3(好),如果任何标准得到1分,则标出一对.

blocks.en: The largest difference is in answer minimality. The single judge flags more long answer spans, while the ensemble is more permissive. The 26 pairs flagged by the ensemble include incomplete spans and long section level answers. The three judges give the same score on all four criteria for only 8.0% of the pairs, showing that their judgments can differ. Therefore, the LLM as Judge results are treated as diagnostic evidence rather than as final measures of dataset quality.

blocks.en: III-F Human Validation Study
blocks.zh: III-F 人类验证研究

blocks.en: Two law graduates independently audited 200 test pairs across all seven Acts (seed 42: copyright 25, designs 24, GI 32, patents 29, plant varieties 28, semiconductor 30, and trade marks 32). A sample of 200 pairs is selected as a practical post hoc audit size while maintaining coverage across all seven Acts. The audit is diagnostic rather than a precise estimate of quality across all 4,462 pairs or of expert IPR annotation accuracy. Pairs were rated from 1 (poor) to 3 (good) for question clarity, answer correctness, and answer minimality; agreement is measured using unweighted and quadratic-weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 16 , 17 ] .

blocks.en: IV Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 数据集分析

blocks.en: This section examines answer length, lexical overlap, span structure, and model performance across the dataset and the seven Acts.

Its average answer length is 35.6 words, about 11 × \times SQuAD’s 3.2 words and 19% longer than CUAD’s 30.0 words, which may increase span boundary complexity. The dataset is fully extractive, contains no unanswerable questions, and uses section level train test separation.

blocks.zh: 4-B 实际分配和业绩

blocks.en: Test F1 ranges from 100.00 for Designs to 53.20 for Plant Varieties. The perfect score for Designs should be viewed with caution because the test set contains only 24 pairs. Across the seven Acts (n = 7), question-context unigram overlap shows a strong negative correlation with F1 ( r = − 0.928 r=-0.928 ). Given the small number of Acts, this correlation should be interpreted as exploratory rather than as evidence of a general relationship. Plant Varieties have the highest overlap (0.636) but the lowest F1. One possible reason is the presence of specialised biological and agricultural terms, although this is not directly tested. Copyright has more multi-clause answers (53.9%) than Patents (13.7%) and also has lower F1 (79.41 versus 98.40).
blocks.zh: 测试F1在设计上从100.00到植物品种53.20不等. 设计组的完美分数应谨慎看待,因为测试集只包含24对. 在七部法案(n=7)中,问题-内容单格重叠与F1(r= - 0.928 r= - 0.928)有很强的负面关联,鉴于法案数量少,这种关联应解释为探索性而非一般关系的证据。 植物品种重叠最多(0.636),但F1. 一个可能的原因是存在专门的生物和农业术语,尽管这并没有直接测试。 版权的多功能解答率(53.9%)高于专利(13.7%),F1(79.41比98.40)。

blocks.en: The answers cover several legal topics, including authority (29.4%), procedure (12.0%), rights (9.5%), conditions (7.9%), definitions (5.8%), duration (2.3%) and penalties (1.7%), while 31.4% fall into other categories. The average question to context word overlap is 0.448 after removing common stopwords. Also, 19.9% of answers contain semicolons and 5.9% contain “subject to,” showing that many answers contain multiple clauses. When the answers are divided into short and long groups using the median length of 33 words, InLegalBERT F1 decreases from 86.24 for short answers to 83.78 for long answers. Multi-clause answers also have lower boundary-sensitive EM than single-clause answers (56.10 versus 66.03). Answers that appear later in the context have slightly lower F1 than earlier answers (84.21 versus 85.83). Overall, answer length, the number of clauses, and the answer’s position in the context are associated with extraction performance.
blocks.zh: 答复涉及若干法律专题,包括权威(29.4%)、程序(12.0%)、权利(9.5%)、条件(7.9%)、定义(5.8%)、期限(2.3%)和惩罚(1.7%),31.4%属于其他类别。 与上下文单词重叠的平均问题在删除常见的句子后为0.448. 此外,19.9%的回答包含分号,5.9%的回答包含“服从”,表明许多回答包含多个条款。 当使用33个字的中位长度将答案分为短组和长组时,InLegalBERT F1从短答案的86.24降至长答案的83.78. 多密解答也有比单密解答(56.10对66.03)更低的边界敏感EM. 在下文后面出现的回答略低于以前的回答(84.21对85.83)。 总体而言,答复长度、条款数量和答复在上下文中的地位与提取性能有关。

blocks.en: V Baseline Experiments & Results
blocks.zh: 五 基线实验和结果

blocks.en: Four BERT based encoder models are fine tuned on the IndicIPR-QA training split (3,710 QA pairs) using the BertForQuestionAnswering architecture [ 18 ] . This architecture predicts the start and end positions of the answer span in the input sequence: [CLS] question [SEP] context [SEP]. The models cover different levels of domain specialisation: BERT base uncased [ 18 ] (general English), LegalBERT-US [ 19 ] (US legal text), InCaseLawBERT [ 20 ] (Indian court judgments), and InLegalBERT [ 11 ] (Indian legal text).
blocks.zh: 四个基于BERT的编码器模型在IndicIPR-QA的训练分割(3,710个QA对)上进行精细调制,使用BertForQuestionAnswering架构[18]. 这个架构预言了答案跨度在输入序列中的始末位置:[CLS]问题[SEP]上下文[SEP]. 这些模型涵盖不同层次的域名专业化:BERT base uncaseed [18](一般英语),LegalBERT-US [19](美国法律文本),InCaseLawBERT [20](印度法院判决)和InLegalBERT [11](印度法律文本).

blocks.en: All encoder models use the same settings: AdamW optimiser, learning rate 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} with 50 warm-up steps and linear decay, weight decay 0.01, effective batch size 32, maximum sequence length 384, document stride 128, 3 training epochs, and random seed 42. The same settings are used for all encoder models to ensure a controlled comparison. The best checkpoint is selected using validation F1. During inference, long contexts are divided into overlapping windows using a stride of 128. A constrained decoder then selects the highest-scoring valid answer span across all windows and returns the exact text from the context. All encoder results reported here are recomputed from the archived checkpoints using this same inference procedure; no model is retrained.
blocks.zh: 所有编码器模型都使用相同的设置: AdamW Opimiser,学习速度 3× 10 − 5 3\ Times 10× 5 },有50个热化步骤和线性衰变,重量衰减 0.01,有效批量大小 32,最大序列长度 384,文档 stride 128, 3 训练时代,和随机种子 42. 所有编码器模型都使用同样的设置,以确保对照比较. 最佳检查点通过验证F1选择. 在推论期间,较长的上下文会使用128的阶梯分成重叠窗口. 受约束的解码器然后在所有窗口中选择得分最高的有效答案,并从上下文返回准确的文本。 此处报告的所有编码器结果都通过同样的推论程序从存档的检查站重新计算;没有模型经过再培训。

blocks.en: Three open instruction tuned LLMs are also evaluated in zero shot and 3 shot settings: Llama 3.1:8B [ 14 ] , Mistral 7B [ 15 ] , and Qwen2.5:7B [ 21 ] . These models come from different model families and have similar sizes of about 7 to 8B parameters. In the zero shot setting, each model receives the statute passage and question and is instructed to copy the answer exactly from the context. In the 3 shot setting, three example QA pairs from the training set are provided as demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 还在零镜头和3个镜头设置中评价了3个开放式指令调制LLM: Llama 3.1:8B [14],Mistral 7B [15],和 Quen2.5:7B [21]. 这些模型来自不同的模型家族,其大小相似,约为7-8B参数. 在零镜头设定中,每个型号都会收到法规通过和提问,并被指示从上下文中准确复制答案. 在3个射击场景中,从培训场景中提供3个实例QA对作为演示.

blocks.en: V-A Results

blocks.en:
Table VII and Figure 3 summarise the results of all baseline systems using exact match (EM), token level F1, and character level F1 (Char-F1). Standard BM25 retrieval [ 22 ] achieves a token level F1 of 20.21, while the oracle window setting reaches 51.30. Both remain below the supervised encoder models. Among the encoders,
InLegalBERT achieves the highest F1 (85.02), followed by LegalBERT-US
(84.66) and InCaseLawBERT (84.37). BERT-base has the lowest encoder F1
(83.33). However, the differences between the encoder models are small, so the results do not provide strong evidence that domain specific pretraining alone leads to better performance.

blocks.en: VI Generalizability Analysis
blocks.zh: 六 一般性分析

blocks.en: Section-level splitting prevents the same source context from appearing in both the training and test sets. The train-test context Jaccard similarity is 0.00 for all seven Acts. Figure 4 shows that 100% of test contexts are unseen in the training split for every Act. Among the 1,234 unique answer token types in the test set, 137 (11.1%) do not appear in the training answers. In addition, 15.3% of test question tokens and 13.7% of test context tokens are not found in the training split. This shows that the test set contains unseen legal provisions and words.
blocks.zh: 科级的拆分使同一来源背景无法出现在培训和测试集中。 列车测试背景 Jaccard 相似度为 0. 图4显示,每部法律的培训都未见100%的测试背景。 在测试集的1,234种独特的回答符号类型中,137种(11.1%)没有出现在培训答案中. 此外,15.3%的试题信使和13.7%的试题上下文信使没有在训练分拆中找到. 这表明,测试集包含了看不见的法律规定和文字.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Novel test-context rate by Act. The 100% rate confirms that no source context is shared between the training and test splits.
blocks.zh: 图4:按法案分列的小说测试文本率。 100%的费率证实,培训与测试分离之间没有共享源背景。

blocks.en: However, the questions are not completely independent across the two splits. Of the 4,462 questions, 4,118 are unique after converting them to lowercase, replacing non-word characters with spaces, and removing extra spaces. Common question openings include “what does” (1,157), “under section” (960), and “what is” (875). These repeated GPT-4o question patterns can appear in both training and test sets. Therefore, the results show how well models answer questions generated by the same process over new legal contexts. They do not measure performance on independently written legal questions.
blocks.zh: 然而,在两个分歧之间,问题并不完全独立。 在4,462个问题中,4,118个问题在转换为小写后是独一无二的,用空格取代非字字符,并去除额外的空格. 常见的问题包括“什么是”(1,157)、“第960节下”和“什么是”(875)。 这些重复的GPT-4o问题模式既可以出现在训练集中,也可以出现在测试集中. 因此,结果表明,模型在新的法律背景下如何很好地回答了同一进程所产生的问题。 它们不衡量独立书面法律问题的业绩。

blocks.en: The 64.81-point gap between BM25 and InLegalBERT indicates that simple word matching alone is not sufficient for this task. However, this gap alone does not prove that the models will generalise to real-world legal questions. The BM25 oracle-window F1 score of 51.30 shows that simple lexical matching still performs poorly even when the correct context is provided.
blocks.zh: BM25和InLegalBERT之间的64.81点差距表明,单是简单的单词匹配不足以完成这项任务. 然而,仅凭这一差距并不能证明这些模式将普遍适用于现实世界的法律问题。 BM25 oracle-window F1的51.30分显示,即使提供了正确的上下文,简单的词汇匹配仍然表现不佳.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 七. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
IndicIPR-QA is an extractive QA benchmark containing 4,462 question-answer pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts covering the seven principal Indian IPR Acts. The dataset is created using GPT-4o with nine automatic quality filters, context-balanced selection, model-based evaluation, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level splitting prevents the same source context from appearing in both the training and test sets. Using the unified sliding-window inference method, fine-tuned InLegalBERT achieves a token-level F1 of 85.02, while BM25 retrieval achieves 20.21. This large difference shows that simple word matching is not enough for this task. Performance also differs across the seven Acts and different types of answers, and most InLegalBERT errors are related to choosing the exact answer boundaries. These results highlight the difficulty of precise answer-span extraction, especially for long and multi-clause answers. IndicIPR-QA provides a benchmark for studying extractive QA over Indian IPR law. The benchmark is limited to English, answerable, single-context questions, and the questions are generated using GPT-4o. Future work can include independently written questions, more Indian languages,
unanswerable questions, and scenario based or multi section questions.
blocks.zh:
IndicIPR-QA是一个采掘性QA基准,包含来自1,116个法定背景的4,462个回答对,涵盖7个主要的印度知识产权法案. 该数据集使用GPT-4o创建,有9个自动质量过滤器,上下文平衡选择,模型评价,以及200平方英尺的人力审计. 科级的拆分使同一来源背景无法出现在培训和测试集中。 使用统一的滑窗推论方法,微调的InLegalBERT实现符号级F1为85.02,而BM25检索则实现20.21. 这种巨大的差异表明简单的字词匹配不足以完成这一任务. 表现也因七部法案和不同类型的答案而不同,大多数InLegalBERT错误与选择准确的答案边界有关. 这些结果凸显出精确的解答-span提取的难度,尤其是对于长而多的解答. IndicIPR-QA为研究印度知识产权法的采掘质量保证提供了一个基准。 该基准仅限于英语,可回答,单文本的问题,这些问题使用GBT-4o生成. 今后的工作可以包括独立的书面问题、更多的印度语言、
无法回答的问题,以及基于情景或多节的问题。
